egressPoints.trigger: User runs `$B pair-agent` (CLI POSTs to local /tunnel/start), or starts the daemon with BROWSE_TUNNEL=1

PRIVACY.md explicitly sanctions this legacy tunnel path ("explicit legacy tunnels if separately enabled").

egressPoints.endpoint: https://<tunnel>.ngrok.io/connect and /health (self-probe round-trip through ngrok edge)

egressPoints.gating: Only reachable after the pair_agent opt-in above — tunnelActive/tunnelUrl cannot be set otherwise. Probes send no user data (GET + ngrok-skip-browser-warning header, 5s timeout); dead tunnels are torn down.

egressPoints.endpoint: Arbitrary user-directed web sites (Playwright page.goto / newtab / navigate-download)
egressPoints.trigger: Explicit commands: goto <url>, newtab, download --navigate — always a user/agent-supplied URL
egressPoints.gating: Contract-sanctioned class ("navigation requests to sites the user directs it to"). Every navigation passes validateNavigationUrl, which blocks cloud-metadata hosts, IPv4-mapped/IPv6 link-local and ULA forms, and dangerous schemes (url-validation.ts:11-40, 228). Mutating commands require bearer auth; tunnel surface has a separate 26-command allowlist.

egressPoints.endpoint: Arbitrary user-supplied URL via page.request.fetch (download and scrape commands)

egressPoints.gating: Same SSRF gate as goto: validateNavigationUrl runs before the fetch (comment at write-commands.ts:1277-1285 documents the IMDS bypass this prevents); 200MB cap; write scope required and --out/write invocations are never allowed over the tunnel (commands.ts js/eval descriptions).

egressPoints.endpoint: User-configured upstream proxy (SOCKS5/HTTP) via SocksClient.createConnection

egressPoints.endpoint: https://frugpmstpnojnhfyimgv.supabase.co/functions/v1/telemetry-ingest (curl POST, batched JSONL)
egressPoints.trigger: browse/src/security.ts logAttempt() fire-and-forget spawns bin/gstack-telemetry-log on prompt-injection attack_attempt events; that script background-spawns bin/gstack-telemetry-sync which uploads
egressPoints.gating: Off by default and consent-gated at two layers: gstack-telemetry-log exits 0 when `gstack-config get telemetry` is off (default "off", bin/gstack-config:35; invalid values coerce to off), and gstack-telemetry-sync re-checks the tier and exits when off. Uploads strip _repo_slug/_branch/repo fields; error_message is redaction-engine-scrubbed fail-closed before it ever touches disk. HOWEVER two semantics need review: (1) security.ts:471 comment claims "anonymous → local only" but gstack-telemetry-sync uploads for the anonymous tier too (it only strips installation_id) — behavior/doc mismatch on what the user consented to; (2) security_url_domain uploads the RAW domain of the visited page where an attack was detected (payloadHash is salted, urlDomain is not), which is browsing data leaving the machine under an opt-in that PRIVACY.md frames as "minimal legacy telemetry".
egressPoints.fix: Either make the anonymous tier genuinely local-only (add `[ "$TIER" = "anonymous" ] && exit 0` to gstack-telemetry-sync) or fix the stale comment in security.ts:471 and the user-facing tier docs so consent matches behavior; consider hashing or eTLD+1-truncating security_url_domain before upload.
